newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: DHAKA STOCKS SEEN WEAKER ON BEARISH SENTIMENT.
newsitem.headline: DHAKA STOCKS SEEN WEAKER ON BEARISH SENTIMENT.

text.p: Shares on the Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) are expected to open weaker on Thursday as investors remained cautious about the outlook of the market, brokers said.
"The bear-run may continue for a fifth straight session as retailers are unlikely to return ahead of the weekend," said broker Mahbub Morshed.
"The state-run Investment Corporation of Bangladesh (ICB) is trying to support the market but other institutions should join the recovery effort to bring back retailers," he said.
The DSE all-share price index lost 1.45 points or 0.15 percent to 952.63 on a turnover of 42.7 million taka on Wednesday.
